questions.question: Which company had the highest revenue in fiscal 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Apple's revenue in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT revenue FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'AAPL' AND fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was Microsoft's net income in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT net_income FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'MSFT' AND fiscal_year = 2022

questions.question: Which company had the highest operating margin in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM ratios WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 AND NOT operating_margin IS NULL ORDER BY operating_margin DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which company had the highest net margin in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM ratios WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 ORDER BY net_margin DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which sector had the highest average net margin in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT c.sector FROM ratios AS r JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE r.fiscal_year = 2023 GROUP BY c.sector ORDER BY AVG(r.net_margin) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many companies had revenue above 100 billion dollars in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 AND revenue > 100e9

questions.question: Which company had the largest total assets in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 ORDER BY total_assets DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which company had the smallest total assets in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 ORDER BY total_assets ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which company generated the most operating cash flow in 2024?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 ORDER BY operating_cash_flow DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was Apple's revenue growth from 2023 to 2024, in percent?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND((b.revenue / a.revenue - 1) * 100, 1) FROM financials AS a JOIN financials AS b ON a.ticker = b.ticker AND b.fiscal_year = a.fiscal_year + 1 WHERE a.ticker = 'AAPL' AND a.fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: Which company had the highest revenue growth from 2022 to 2023, in percent?
questions.sql: SELECT a.ticker FROM financials AS a JOIN financials AS b ON a.ticker = b.ticker AND b.fiscal_year = a.fiscal_year + 1 WHERE a.fiscal_year = 2022 ORDER BY b.revenue / a.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which companies had lower net income in 2023 than in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT a.ticker FROM financials AS a JOIN financials AS b ON a.ticker = b.ticker AND b.fiscal_year = a.fiscal_year + 1 WHERE a.fiscal_year = 2022 AND b.net_income < a.net_income ORDER BY a.ticker

questions.question: What was the total revenue of the Technology sector in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(f.revenue) FROM financials AS f JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE c.sector = 'Technology' AND f.fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was the average revenue of Healthcare companies in 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(f.revenue) FROM financials AS f JOIN companies AS c USING (ticker) WHERE c.sector = 'Healthcare' AND f.fiscal_year = 2022

questions.question: Which companies have no operating income values in this dataset?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials GROUP BY ticker HAVING COUNT(operating_income) = 0 ORDER BY ticker

questions.question: What was Johnson & Johnson's pretax margin in 2023, in percent?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(pretax_margin * 100, 1) FROM ratios WHERE ticker = 'JNJ' AND fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: What was Coca-Cola's ratio of operating cash flow to net income in 2023?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(operating_cash_flow / net_income, 2) FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'KO' AND fiscal_year = 2023

questions.question: Which company had the highest net income in 2021?
questions.sql: SELECT ticker FROM financials WHERE fiscal_year = 2021 ORDER BY net_income DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many fiscal years of data do we have for Walmart?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financials WHERE ticker = 'WMT'
